column3: Kirino Route · There's No Way My Little Sister Denies Her Otaku Hobby
Kuroneko...?
Are you for real? Humans can't talk with cats.
N-No, that's not it! What I'm referring to is, that Gothic Lolita! Our friend!
Huh? Friend?
Hey, even if you don't have many human friends, how can you treat a cat as a friend? The cat will surely be troubled.
Are you an idiot!?
Besides, to begin with, how could you even communicate with animals?
Isn't that a given? What is your head filled with? A field of flowers?
I-Isn't that what you said?
Hey... Kuroneko is your friend's handle name.
Furthermore, how could cats talk? Do you really believe in such a thing?
Then, who's that Kuroneko? I don't have such a friend!
In any case, could you please tell the truth, in Japanese?
You should be honest as well...
Huh? I'm being extremely honest!
Don't play dumb. You've been doing nothing but dodging my questions from the start.
S-Stop with your false accusations!
I-I'm being honest!
Huh!? That's considered honest!?
You, who's interested in only cats and glasses?
D-Don't treat others like they have some strange interests!
...I get it. Let's change the topic then. So, do you know about Saori? The one that always goes, 'gozaru, gozaru'.
Huh? 'gozaru'? So you have friends that are ninjas or samurai?
She's not a samurai! Come on, it's Saori, the huge girl with swirly glasses!
You're so persistent! I've never seen such a person appear in front of me even once in my life!
Rather, there's no way you could find such a person anywhere in Japan, right?
But such a person does in fact exist.
*sigh*... You, calm down a little. How could our conversation drift into the topic of samurai?
Guh... that's true...
I'm currently talking about things regarding your friends. Do you understand?
H-How would I know what's going on inside your head!
Tch... Your delusions have become really severe, you know that? Should I have you consult a doctor?
Doctor...?
Yes, doctor! You've been saying strange things since earlier on. Did you hit your head during the school trip?
Hey, Kirino!
W-What? Don't suddenly come close to me!
You... have you really forgotten all about Saori and Kuroneko?
It's all a joke, right?
How many times must I repeat myself? I'm completely serious!
Kirino...
W-What?
...Could it be...!?
...? What's with the stupid look?
I-I'll ask you once more. You really don't know Kuroneko or Saori?
You're really persistent! Enough already!!
No matter how much you played around on your school trip, isn't this cruel? Cut it out already, you Kyoto idiot!
If you want to see ninjas or samurai, why don't you go visit the Uzumasa movie village? Ah, and you don't have to come back after that.
This....isn't a joke.
Kirino... Could it be that you...!?
...What? Don't look at me with strange eyes like that.
